findings.justification: E11 is a derived metric showing operating margin for fiscal year 2025 (period 2024-09-29 to 2025-09-27) as 0.3197 or 31.97%, which exceeds 30%. The period_status is COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION and matches the claim period exactly.

E7 shows operating income of $133,050 million for fiscal year 2025 (2024-09-29 to 2025-09-27), and E8 shows revenue of $416,161 million for the same period. Operating margin = 133,050 / 416,161 = 0.3197 or 31.97%, which exceeds 30%. Both facts have period_status EXACT_MATCH.

E14 provides gross margin figures for fiscal year 2025, showing total gross margin of $195,201 million and gross margin percentage of 46.9%. However, gross margin is different from operating margin (which subtracts operating expenses from gross profit). This is related context but does not directly establish the operating margin level.

E9 and E10 provide operating income ($123,216 million) and revenue ($391,035 million) for fiscal year 2024 (2023-10-01 to 2024-09-28), which is the comparison period, not the claim period of fiscal year 2025. These figures are for a different period and do not decide the claim about FY2025.

E11 is a derived metric showing operating margin for fiscal year 2025 (period 2024-09-29 to 2025-09-27) as 0.3197, which is greater than 0.3. The period_status is COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION and matches the claim period exactly.

E7 shows operating income of $133,050 million for fiscal year 2025 (2024-09-29 to 2025-09-27), and E8 shows revenue of $416,161 million for the same period. Operating margin = 133,050 / 416,161 = 0.3197, which is greater than 0.3. Both facts have period_status EXACT_MATCH.

E9 and E10 provide operating income ($123,216 million) and revenue ($391,035 million) for fiscal year 2024 (2023-10-01 to 2024-09-28), which is the comparison period, not the claim period of fiscal year 2025. These figures are for a different period and do not decide the numeric assertion about FY2025.
